title: Hut 8 Posts $189.5M Q3 Net Incomey on Unrealized Crypto Gains Despite Revenue Slump
summary:
The digital infrastructure company's third-quarter revenue missed analysts' expectations of $75.9M, falling to $71.1M from $83.5M a year earlier. Hut 8 reported a net income of $189.5M, though the figure was significantly impacted by $413.8M in gains from digital assets that were primarily unrealized.

To support capital returns, the firm sold about 3,102 BTC to finance $250M in share repurchases against a $1B authorization. On the operational side, the company increased its energy capacity under exclusivity by 1,300 MW for a total of 3,180 MW and announced that 1,330 MW of AI data center capacity is currently under construction.
